items.claim: Davis表示對先前揭露的700億美元近期上市管線總機會存在上調空間
items.quote: you should assume we see upside to the $70 billion
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Davis確認公司會上調700億美元的數字，只是時程未定
items.quote: you're going to see us raise that number
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Li說明INT黑色素瘤Phase II五年追蹤數據顯示1年時腫瘤消失的病人多數在3年、5年仍維持無癌狀態
items.quote: remain largely so at 3 years, were largely so at 5 years
items.speaker: Dean Li (President, Merck Research Labs)

items.claim: Li表示sac-TMT分子本身與前兩代TROP2 ADC不同，是差異化關鍵
items.quote: was different than the previous two
items.speaker: Dean Li (President, Merck Research Labs)

items.claim: Davis預期LIPFENDRA的Medicare覆蓋將在2028年到位
items.quote: We expect to have Medicare coverage by 2028.
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Davis說明LIPFENDRA的目標不是搶現有PCSK9注射針劑5%市占，而是把整體PCSK9合格族群滲透率拉到50%以上
items.quote: My goal is not to have 5% of people on PCSK9
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Li說FDA把LIPFENDRA的biomarker特性與有心血管結果數據的抗體類PCSK9藥物相提並論，視為正面訊號
items.quote: we view that as all positive movement
items.speaker: Dean Li (President, Merck Research Labs)

items.claim: Davis轉述業務代表回報的早期病人端反應正面
items.quote: The short answer, it's all positive.
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Davis重申公司致力於把免疫學列為重要治療領域
items.quote: we are committed to playing in immunology
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Li表示Tulisokibart兩項Phase III會有部分數據在今年秋天釋出
items.quote: We should be getting some of that data this fall.
items.speaker: Dean Li (President, Merck Research Labs)

items.claim: Davis強調公司資產布局不只靠中國，而是全球尋找科學
items.quote: We source from around the world.
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Davis舉AI在分子設計與最佳化上的效益為目前最被低估的AI應用案例
items.quote: molecular design and molecular design optimization
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

items.claim: Davis表示即使340B相關立法推進，對公司財務衝擊不算重大
items.quote: they're not material to us, frankly
items.speaker: Robert Davis (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Is that a this-year event or a next-year event? (指700億美元管線數字何時上調)
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給明確時間點，只說「it's coming」與「to be determined in the near term」，語氣保留不承諾時程

qa_flags.question: Maybe just again, any update on when we might see that first set of full Phase III data? Is this something that we could see at the UEGW conference?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 先以「If I could reframe the question a little bit」把焦點從IBD/會議時程轉向更廣的細胞激素節點策略，稍後才簡短回答資料時程

qa_flags.question: what does that mean for your sac-TMT program in the event that, let's say, the biomarker population only is positive?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未正面給判斷，只說會「look very deeply」並強調要看後續資料，屬條件式保留回答
